chunks: And among his words (peace be upon him) is that he would supplicate with it.
ai.seo_question: What is the introductory phrase for Ali's supplications in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This introductory phrase from Nahj al-Balagha, compiled by Sharif al-Radi, signals a specific supplication (dua) frequently recited by Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), establishing it as a core element of his personal devotional practice. In Shia scholarly tradition, such recurring supplications are viewed not merely as liturgical texts but as profound expressions of the Imam's spiritual state and theological understanding, offering believers a model for connecting with the Divine through structured remembrance.
